biological.citation: Integrative Single-Cell and Spatial Transcriptomics Analysis Reveals ECM-remodeling Cancer-associated Fibroblast-Derived POSTN as a Key Mediator in Pancreatic Ductal Adenocarcinoma Progression (PMID: 40520021)
biological.summary: SOX11 was identified as a key transcription factor in ECM-remodeling fibroblasts, a subpopulation enriched in pancreatic ductal adenocarcinoma tumors and associated with poor prognosis. SOX11+ fibroblasts were located at the terminal stage of the fibroblast pseudotime trajectory and interact with epithelial cells through the POSTN-ITGAV/ITGB5 axis.
biological.sample_size: large-scale single-cell and spatial transcriptomics dataset

biological.citation: Molecular Pathogenesis of Mantle Cell Lymphoma (PMID: 32861278)
biological.summary: SOX11 expression determines an aggressive phenotype in mantle cell lymphoma (MCL) associated with accumulation of chromosomal alterations and somatic gene mutations. SOX11-negative leukemic non-nodal MCL follows an indolent clinical evolution, while SOX11-positive conventional MCL exhibits aggressive behavior.

biological.citation: Human fetal cerebellar cell atlas informs medulloblastoma origin and oncogenesis (PMID: 36450980)
biological.summary: SOX11 was identified as a transcriptional determinant in transitional cerebellar progenitors that are enriched in aggressive medulloblastoma subgroup 3 and metastatic tumors. Single-cell multi-omics revealed that SOX11 is part of a regulatory network controlling MYC-targeted super-enhancers, and SOX11 expression correlates with clinical prognosis in group 3 medulloblastomas.
biological.sample_size: human fetal cerebella and medulloblastoma single-cell profiles

biological.citation: SOX11 as a potential prognostic biomarker in hepatocellular carcinoma linked to immune infiltration and ferroptosis (PMID: 39246708)
biological.summary: SOX11 was significantly elevated in hepatocellular carcinoma (HCC) tumors. Decreased SOX11 levels in HepG2 and HuH7 cell lines resulted in reduced proliferation and migration. SOX11 levels correlated with HCC stage, histologic grade, and independently predicted overall and disease-specific survival.
biological.sample_size: TCGA-LIHC dataset; HepG2 and HuH7 cell lines

biological.citation: Specification of claustro-amygdalar and palaeocortical neurons and circuits (PMID: 39814878)
biological.summary: SOX11, together with SOX4 and TFAP2D, has a pivotal role in the development and identity of ventrolateral pallial excitatory neurons. Loss of SOX4 and SOX11 in post-mitotic excitatory neurons results in marked reduction in the size of the basolateral amygdala complex, claustrum, and piriform cortex, with altered PFC connectivity and learned threat-response behaviors.

biological.citation: Single-Cell and Spatial Transcriptome Analysis of Dermal Fibroblast Development in Perinatal Mouse Skin (PMID: 38072389)
biological.summary: Sox11 was identified as a putative key driver gene for the dermal papilla fibroblast trajectory during skin development, with expression detected in spatially identified dermal papilla cell types across embryonic and postnatal developmental stages.
biological.sample_size: time-series single-cell RNA-seq from embryonic days 13.5-16.5 and postnatal days 0-4

biological.citation: SOX11, CD70, and Treg cells configure the tumor-immune microenvironment of aggressive mantle cell lymphoma (PMID: 34189576)
biological.summary: SOX11 expression in mantle cell lymphoma is associated with an immunosuppressive microenvironment. SOX11+ MCL had significantly lower T-cell intratumoral infiltration and reduced expression of MHC and T-cell costimulation transcripts. CD70 was identified as a SOX11 direct target gene, whose overexpression in SOX11+ tumor cells was induced by CD40L in vitro and associated with increased Treg cell infiltration.
biological.sample_size: 730 immune-related genes analyzed; primary nodal MCL cases

biological.citation: SOX11: friend or foe in tumor prevention and carcinogenesis? (PMID: 31210798)
biological.summary: Comprehensive review establishing SOX11 as a transcription factor with dual roles in cancer: elevated expression in many tumors correlates with increased cancer cell survival, inhibited differentiation, and tumor progression through induction of metastasis and angiogenesis, though in limited malignancies SOX11 functions as a tumor suppressor.

biological.citation: ASHG 2016 - SOX11 is necessary for development of the bony labyrinth (E.D. Sperry et al.)
biological.summary: Sox11 is necessary for proper development of the inner ear bony labyrinth. Sox11 heterozygous and homozygous knockout mice exhibited lateral and posterior semicircular canal dysplasia. Sox11 mutant ears showed spatiotemporal misregulation of genes critical for ear morphogenesis (Bmp4, Otx1, Shh). Sox11 may mediate effects of CHD7 during inner ear development, relevant to Coffin-Siris and CHARGE syndromes.

biological.citation: ASHG 2023 - Deciphering Transcriptional Regulatory Elements during Inhibitory Interneuron Differentiation using Deep Learning (R. Birnbaum et al.)
biological.summary: SOX11 motifs were enriched in active enhancers of human interneuron progenitors. SOX4 and SOX11 factors show cooperativity in controlling active enhancers of neuronal progenitors, identified through deep learning analysis of ATAC-seq and H3K27ac/me3 ChIP-seq data from human interneuron progenitors.
biological.sample_size: human interneuron progenitor regulatory element datasets
